# Harness Gap Handoff — Shared Contract

The machine-readable handoff between `harness-audit` (emits) and `harness-apply` (consumes). Both skills cite this file as the single source of truth.

## Block schema

```yaml
## Harness gap handoff
# Generated by: harness-audit
# Consumed by:   harness-apply (skips any interview question whose gate category is already covered)

surfaces_present:
  claude_global: true|false   # any hook script registered in settings.json.template that is currently loaded (symlink live)
  claude_project: true|false  # <project>/.claude/hooks/ exists, scripts non-empty, wired in .claude/settings.json or settings.local.json
  pi: true|false              # ~/.pi/agent/extensions/harness-gates/ exists AND extensions/harness-gates is a positive entry (no `-` prefix) in .pi/agent/settings.json(.template)

gates:
  - category: format-on-edit        # bash / write / edit
    coverage: claude-global | claude-project | pi | missing
    surface: <list of surfaces currently covering it>

  - category: lint-on-edit
    coverage: ...
    surface: ...

  - category: validate-syntax
    coverage: ...

  - category: block-bash-pattern
    coverage: ...

  - category: block-path-access    # write + read protection
    coverage: ...

  - category: staged-static-check  # changed-files lint+typecheck on git diff --cached
    coverage: ...

  - category: pre-git-checks       # whole-project typecheck/build/test (opt-in, slow)
    coverage: ...

  - category: stop-self-review     # advisory Stop-time reminder
    coverage: ...

recommended_scope: project | global
  # project: scripts go under <project>/.claude/hooks/, wired into <project>/.claude/settings.json(.local.json).
  # global:  scripts go under dotfiles/.claude/hooks/ (symlinked to ~/.claude/hooks/), wired into dotfiles' settings template + the live file.
```

## Coverage values (closed set)

Each gate row picks exactly one `coverage`:

- **claude-global** — installed at the dotfiles layer; fires in any project via `settings.json.template` + symlink.
- **claude-project** — installed at the project layer; fires only in that project.
- **pi** — fires in Pi via the global `harness-gates` adapter (the adapter discovers Claude hook scripts at runtime and runs them; `pi` coverage implies at least one of the Claude-surface rows is non-missing, otherwise Pi is a no-op).
- **missing** — no surface fires this gate.

A row may also carry a `surface: [...]` array naming every surface currently implementing it (a single gate can be covered by multiple surfaces — e.g. `format-on-edit` runs in Claude-project AND in Pi).

## Recommended scope

The auditor picks one of:

- **project** — the audit target repo has its own `.claude/` and should own its gates.
- **global** — the audit target is best served by the user's dotfiles (no project-local scripts).

`harness-apply` reads `recommended_scope` to pre-fill its "global vs project" interview question and skips confirmation.

## Versioning

This is schema v1 (the four-element coverage set). Breaking changes bump the schema version in the comment header; consumers must ignore unknown keys.
